meta.purpose: Regression suite for the MatrixContent selection engine. Run with: python scripts/validate_matrixcontent.py --evals evals/eval-cases.json
meta.note: Expectations are deliberately looser than observed output. They pin behaviour that must not regress (goal family, master pillar family, diversity floors, no hard conflicts), not the exact ranking, which is allowed to shift as the overlay is tuned. v2 adds channel/medium gating, register and Schwartz awareness-stage assertions; these encode the four defects the 10-round audit found.
